verdicts.decision_note: The freelancer claims that smart-contract minting is operational on the Base testnet.
The client explicitly establishes an unlimited-mint NFT ebook on Base with a $15 mint price.
The client specifies the title of the memoir ebook offered through the mint.
The freelancer reports that production is deployed and ready for live mint testing without claiming independent verification.
The client reports a concrete production mint failure with a simulation error.
The client confirms a successful USDC mint and observes the resulting NFT on the dashboard.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Very cool, but there are bugs.

**I tried to mint a couple times last night, with ETH in my wallet (no USDC), but it seems to have failed, yet, on <http://ProjectRebuild.xyz|ProjectRebuild.xyz> it says i have minted twice.**

Also, i used no referral code, so (not sure what should have happened to the commission and ticket on mint 1, as its mean to go to an already minted NFT holder... a one off edge case i hadn't thought of, but) mint 2 should have allocated the commission and ticket to mint 1 - (Maybe this is due to the mint not going through)

Also, when i click to view NFT from the dashboard, the book cover is too big and cut off, and (maybe because the mint didn't actually work) im not sure how to view the actual book.

Ill try minting now with USDC and see what happens
